urgent.heading: Tsalela umnxeba ku-10177 okanye uye ngqo esibhedlele ukuba
urgent.primary_message: Ingxaki yoxinzelelo lwegazi (BP ngaphezu kwe-180/120 eneempawu) yimeko engxamisekileyo. Musa ukulinda - kunokubangela isifo okanye isifo sentliziyo.
red_flags: Ukufundwa kweBP ngaphezulu kwe-180/120 kunye neempawu
Intloko ebuhlungu eneengxaki zombono okanye isiyezi
Ubuthathaka ngequbuliso, ukuba ndindisholo, okanye ukudideka (kusenokuba sistrowuku)
Isicaphucaphu, ukugabha, okanye ukuxhalaba kakhulu ngeBP ephezulu
Ukopha ngeempumlo ezingayi kuyeka kunye nokufundwa kweBP ephezulu
Igazi kumchamo okanye ukulahleka ngokukhawuleza kolawulo lwesinyi

what_is_it.heading: Uxinzelelo lwegazi ngokwemiqathango ecacileyo
what_is_it.lede: Uxinzelelo lwegazi ngamandla egazi elityhala kwiindonga zemithambo yakho. Xa loo mandla ehlala ephezulu kakhulu ixesha elide, yonakalisa imithambo kunye namalungu anikezelayo - ngokuthula, kwiminyaka.
paragraphs: Ufundo oluqhelekileyo lumalunga ne-120/80. Uxinzelelo lwegazi oluphezulu (uxinzelelo lwegazi) ngokuqhelekileyo luyi-140/90 okanye ngaphezulu, lulinganiswa ngaphezu kwesihlandlo esinye. Inombolo yokuqala luxinzelelo xa intliziyo ibetha, okwesibini luxinzelelo phakathi kweebhithi.

Abantu abaninzi abanoxinzelelo lwegazi baziva bephile qete. Umonakalo wakha ngokuthula ngasemva-kwintliziyo, ingqondo, izintso, kunye namehlo-de kube yinto enzulu efana ne-stroke okanye ukuhlaselwa yintliziyo. Yiyo loo nto wonke umntu omdala efuna ukujongwa rhoqo, nokuba uziva uphilile.

items.headline: 1 ku3
items.body: Abantu abadala baseMzantsi Afrika banoxinzelelo lwegazi oluphezulu. Abaninzi abazi.

items.headline: Cwaka
items.body: Ngokuqhelekileyo akukho zimpawu de kwenziwe umonakalo. Kukufunda kuphela okukuxelela inyaniso.

items.headline: Iyanyangeka
items.body: Ukuhlolwa simahla kunye namayeza asimahla kuzo zonke iikliniki. Uninzi lweemeko zilawulwa ngethebhulethi enye yemihla ngemihla.

items.headline: Intlawulo enkulu
items.body: Ukunciphisa uxinzelelo lwegazi kunciphisa umngcipheko we-stroke ukuya kuthi ga kwi-40% kunye nomngcipheko wokuhlaselwa yintliziyo ukuya kuma-25%.

pull_quote.text: Ukuba awukhange uhlolwe uxinzelelo lwegazi kunyaka ophelileyo, yenze kule nyanga. Kuthatha imizuzwana engama-30. Inokongeza iminyaka eli-10 kubomi bakho.

signs.heading: Into onokuthi uzive - kunye nento oqhele ukuyenza
signs.lede: Uxinzelelo lwegazi oluphezulu lubizwa ngokuba ngumbulali othuleyo ngesizathu. Abantu abaninzi baziva beqhelekile ngokupheleleyo. Uphawu oluthembekileyo kuphela kukufunda ngokwalo.

items.title: Ngokuqhelekileyo - akukho nto
items.description: Abantu abaninzi abanoxinzelelo lwegazi abanazo kwaphela iimpawu. Abaninzi bafumanisa kuphela xa benestroke okanye isifo sentliziyo.

items.title: Xa ufundo luphezulu kakhulu
items.description: Iintloko ezibuhlungu, umbono ophazamisayo, intlungu yesifuba, ukuphefumula okufutshane, okanye ukuphuma kweempumlo kunokwenzeka - kodwa kuphela kumanqanaba ayingozi. Ezi ziimeko zikaxakeka.

items.title: Thembela kumatshini, hayi iimvakalelo
items.description: Iimpawu azikwazi ukukuxelela uxinzelelo lwegazi lakho. Nabantu abanoxinzelelo olukhulu loxinzelelo lwegazi baziva bephile qete. Kuphela kukufunda inyaniso.

items.fact: Ngokuqinisekileyo awufuni. Uxinzelelo lwegazi luthe cwaka kubantu abaninzi. Ekuphela kwendlela yokwazi kukulinganisa.

items.myth: Kufuneka ndizikhathaze ngetyuwa kuphela ukuba ndiyigalele etafileni.
items.fact: Ityuwa eninzi esiyityayo ifihliwe - kwisonka, kwinyama ecutshungulwayo, umgubo wesobho, i-takeaways, kunye nenye itshizi. I-shaker inxalenye encinci.

items.myth: Xa uxinzelelo lwegazi luqhelekile, ndiyakwazi ukumisa iipilisi.
items.fact: Uxinzelelo lwegazi lwakho luqhelekile ngenxa yeepilisi. Banqande, kwaye iphinde inyukele phezulu. Uxinzelelo lwegazi luyalawulwa, alunyangeki.

items.myth: Amayeza oxinzelelo lwegazi aneziphumo ebezingalindelekanga ezibi.
items.fact: Amayeza anamhlanje anyanyezelwa kakuhle ngabantu abaninzi. Ukuba eyakho ibangela iingxaki, xelela ikliniki yakho - zininzi iindlela ongakhetha kuzo.

prevention.heading: Ungawagcina njani amanani akho phantsi
prevention.lede: Nokuba utshintsho oluncinci lwendlela yokuphila lunokwehlisa uxinzelelo lwegazi ngamanqaku angama-5-10. Uninzi lwabantu abakunyango banokuthoba idosi kunye nendlela yokuphila engaguqukiyo besebenza ecaleni kwabo.

items.title: Ityuwa encinci
items.description: Pheka kunye nemifuno, i-lemon, igalikhi, iziqholo. Funda iilebhile - nantoni na engaphezu kwe-1.5g yetyuwa nge-100g iphezulu. Zimisele ukuba ngaphantsi kwe-5g yetyuwa ngosuku xa iyonke.

items.title: Hambisa yonke imihla
items.description: Imizuzu engama-30 yokuhamba ngokukhawuleza, iintsuku ezi-5 ngeveki, yehlisa uxinzelelo lwegazi ngokulinganiswayo kwiiveki nje ezimbalwa. Isimahla, ifumaneka kuyo yonke indawo.

items.title: Ubunzima obunempilo
items.description: Ukuphulukana ne-5 kg ​​kunokwehlisa uxinzelelo lwegazi kakhulu. Gxininisa kutshintsho olucothayo, oluzinzileyo - hayi izidlo eziphazamisekileyo.

items.title: Jonga rhoqo
items.description: Wonke umntu omdala kufuneka abe noxinzelelo lwegazi ubuncinane ngonyaka - rhoqo ukuba umgca womda okanye ngaphezulu kwama-50. Isimahla kwikliniki nganye nakwiikhemesti ezininzi.

items.title: Ukuba awuzange uhlolwe, okanye sele kudlule unyaka
items.description: Ngena kuyo nayiphi na iklinikhi karhulumente okanye ikhemesti kwaye ubuze. Imizuzu emibini. Akukho dinga. Mahala.

items.title: Ukuba ukufunda kwakho kuphezulu kanye
items.description: Yiphinde ijongwe kwakhona kwiiveki ezi-1 ukuya kwezi-2 ezizayo. Ukufundwa okuphezulu okukodwa akusiyo isifo - kodwa sisizathu sokuqinisekisa.

items.title: Ukuba ufunyanisiwe
items.description: Qala amayeza njengoko kuchaziwe. Thatha yonke imihla ngexesha elifanayo. Ukutsiba iidosi kuvumela uxinzelelo lunyuke kwaye luhle - lubi ngakumbi kunoxinzelelo oluphezulu oluzinzileyo.

items.title: Ukuba uziva uphilile kodwa unehypertension
items.description: Musa ukuyeka amayeza akho. Inqaku lonyango kukuziva ulungile ngelixa ugcina amanani ekhuselekile. Qhubeka kanye njengoko kumiselweyo.

items.title: Landela amanani akho
items.description: Thenga icuff yekhaya ukuba unako (malunga nama-R400 kwiikhemesti ezininzi). Funda kanye okanye kabini ngeveki. Yiza nelog kutyelelo lwasekliniki.

get_help.heading: Uqale phi
get_help.lede: Ukhathalelo loxinzelelo lwegazi yenye yezinto ezenza kakuhle kakhulu iikliniki zoluntu zaseMzantsi Afrika. Ngena ngaphakathi. Akukho dinga lifunekayo.

helplines.description: Ikliniki nganye karhulumente ibonelela ngokujonga uxinzelelo lwegazi simahla kunye namayeza odidi lokuqala asimahla
